whyThisMatters:
Fidelatoo replaces the paper stamp card with a digital one, for a local shop or a franchise. It started in 2023. The company says it is in more than twenty-five countries and has about fourteen hundred fifty users. Those user counts are theirs.

A one-line note on 1 October was the first time it appeared here, at about the same monthly level and a few fewer subscriptions. This is the full page. Two hundred forty-four Stripe subscriptions. The last 30 days sit a little above the monthly line. The year and the all-time total are both large next to the monthly figure, which fits a product that has been charging for a while. Margin about sixty percent, claimed.

You pay so the points live somewhere the customer can open.
